behavior: `Toggle`, `Switch` and `Select.Trigger` accept `focusableWhenDisabled`. With the prop, a disabled control stays in the tab order with `aria-disabled="true"` and keeps the focus. A `ToggleGroup` whose toggles are all disabled with the prop keeps one tab stop. A `Toolbar` reaches such toggles with the arrow keys. A disabled `Switch` that keeps the focus enters no form data, blocks no constraint validation and does not touch its field at a blur. It ignores a press, its label, Space and Enter. A disabled `Select.Trigger` does not open the popup. A Tab away or a press outside its open popup leaves its field untouched. Base UI gives `focusableWhenDisabled` to `Button` and the `Toolbar` items only.
